LanguageData.SSC_BodyManagement_MilkTip: Toggle milk production in this body. Switching it off only stops milk production; it does not remove permanent lactation or empty stored milk.
LanguageData.SSC_BodyManagement_FertilityTip: Toggle whether this body is allowed to conceive. This cannot be switched off during pregnancy.
LanguageData.SSC_BodyManagement_BodyChanged: The body's condition has changed. Check it again before making adjustments.
LanguageData.SSC_BodyManagement_CannotChange: The fertility state cannot be adjusted right now.
LanguageData.SSC_BodyManagement_NotStarted: This body has not yet undergone uterine development.
LanguageData.SSC_BodyManagement_NotComplete: Uterine development is not yet complete; conception is still unavailable.
LanguageData.SSC_BodyManagement_PregnancyBlocked: Fertility cannot be switched off during pregnancy.
LanguageData.SSC_BodyManagement_FertilityConfigUnavai: The fertility configuration for uterine development is unavailable.
